audit_method: Independently recomputed with Python standard library from all 30 P1 and 24 P2 episode.json files, using geometry x seed pairs; did not import aggregate/analyze_ppo code.

metric_definitions.physical: stored physical_strict (=success and no substep physical flag), verified independently below
metric_definitions.no_intervention_physical: physical_strict and fallback_periods==0 and backup_periods==0; deadline excluded
metric_definitions.strict_mainline: success and no substep violation and no QP fallback and no measured period>100ms

caveats: The dataset has 6 scenario units / 2 geometries, not 54 independent scenarios.
P1 and P2 run_episode.py hashes differ; other 5 logged source files match.
P2 eval uses stochastic model.act default, not deterministic mean; episode torch seed reuses the scenario seed.
Stored strict_hist ignores fallback; A3 coupled32002 is strict_hist true with 1 QP fallback.
P1 and P2 evaluate.py run.json each specify 3 parallel workers, so recorded deadline differences are not serial runtime validation.
All 108 PPO training episode logs are present and counted in training_rollout_audit. The referenced .pt checkpoint binaries are absent; no model checkpoint was replayed for this report.

training_rollout_audit.note: Counts recomputed from all raw training episode.json files. Group names identify pre-update behavior policies, not post-update evaluation checkpoints.
